chunks: 5337 - In the narration of Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā ibn ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī, from Muḥammad ibn Hārūn, from Abū Yaḥyā al-Wāsiṭī, who raised it to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, he said:
"The child comes from the left testicle, so when it is severed, for it there are two-thirds of the diyyah, and in the right is one-third of the diyyah."

key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: financial blood money compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.ثُلُثَا الدِّيَةِ: two-thirds of the full blood money
key_terms.ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ: one-third of the full blood money

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for severing the left or right testicle in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the diyyah for injury to the testicles, assigning two-thirds of the blood money to the left and one-third to the right. The ruling is presented in connection with the statement that procreation is associated with the left testicle.
